profile.headline: Engineering Manager | Consumer Product Experiences at Global Scale | Fire TV & Echo Show | GenAI Enablement
profile.summary:
Senior engineering leader with 10+ years of experience building and scaling globally distributed consumer product experiences. Currently lead Amazon Photos experiences across Echo Show and Fire TV devices, delivering features to 300M+ devices across 30+ countries, with select surfaces exceeding 1B+ monthly interactions.

My experience spans consumer products, onboarding and engagement systems, distributed platforms, and operational scaling. I specialize in leading cross-functional engineering teams through high-impact product launches, executive-critical initiatives, and execution improvements that increase velocity while maintaining a high quality bar.

Most recently, I led a GenAI enablement initiative across approximately 95 engineers focused on integrating AI into software development workflows to improve development efficiency and delivery speed.

I’m particularly interested in opportunities involving consumer products, AI-enabled experiences, and globally scaled customer platforms.

positions.title: Assistant Tennis Coach
